summary_markdown: The conversation focused on updating router firmware and ensuring consistent hardware for data collection. [p2] confirmed compiling a clean v52 version of the firmware and uploading it to the RMS, suggesting deployment to routers in Dnipro and two office routers (one via 4G, one via proxy). Concerns were raised regarding the process for setting up a proxy connection for an individual. Multiple participants stressed the need for all eight routers to have identical antennas, as varying hardware would lead to inconsistent data that needs comparison.
decisions: The firmware v52 was compiled and uploaded to the RMS.
All eight routers must use identical antennas.
action_items: Confirm proxy setup process for an individual (e.g., providing a Docker image).
Ensure all hardware components are standardized before data comparison.
